text:
Venue managers send staffing requests from
the mobile app. When you approve a

request, Crewflow sends an offer to each
person you selected. This tutorial uses

Open Venue Offers in the sidebar. Requests
waiting for you show Pending approval.

Open the pending request. The drawer shows
the venue, role, times, and the staff the

Here, two places are still open, so select
staff to fill them.

On the Select Staff page, tick the people
you want, then select Confirm.
With every place filled, select Approve.

The staffing board opens, with the new
offers in the Offered lane. Each staff
member still needs to accept their offer.
